instruction.name: vexth.wu.hu
instruction.description: Zero-extend 16-bit elements in the higher half of every 128-bit vector of `a` to 32-bit.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Consecutive unrolled copies form a vector-register dependency chain. Measured with unroll=100000 to amortise call overhead.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vexth.wu.hu $vr0, $vr8; vexth.wu.hu $vr1, $vr9; vexth.wu.hu $vr2, $vr10; vexth.wu.hu $vr3, $vr11; vexth.wu.hu $vr4, $vr12; vexth.wu.hu $vr5, $vr13; vexth.wu.hu $vr6, $vr14; vexth.wu.hu $vr7, $vr15
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr15, $r4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; vreplgr2vr.b $vr15, $r4' --asm 'vexth.wu.hu $vr0, $vr8; vexth.wu.hu $vr1, $vr9; vexth.wu.hu $vr2, $vr10; vexth.wu.hu $vr3, $vr11; vexth.wu.hu $vr4, $vr12; vexth.wu.hu $vr5, $vr13; vexth.wu.hu $vr6, $vr14; vexth.wu.hu $vr7, $vr15'
throughput.notes: 8 independent instructions take 2.12 cycles. Measured CPI 0.2650; a repeat run with --unroll 250 --unroll2 1000 gives the nominal 0.25. Large unroll factors inflate short bodies through L1I pressure.

notes: LSX vector instruction. Measured on LA664 with register-only operands; latency uses a dependent chain (unroll=100000), throughput uses 8 independent lanes (unroll=1000).
